newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foster's says China profits delayed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foster's says China profits delayed.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said on Monday profits from its beer, brewing and distribution operations in China had been delayed until around 1999/2000 due to generally poorer than expected margins.
"Our internal expectations would have had us making a profit in 1998, but I think that's probably been put off by at least a year," Foster's chief executive Ted Kunkel told reporters.
